title: liparis lyonii
intro: Liparis lyonii, commonly known as Japanese orchid or golden lip orchid, is a flowering plant species belonging to the orchid family. The health benefits of Liparis lyonii include its potential to lower blood sugar levels and act as an anti-inflammatory agent, which can aid in alleviating various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
